facts.text: The Comanche people were historically divided into several dominant bands, including the Yaparuhka, Kotsoteka, Nokoni, Penateka, and Kwahadi.
Comanche culture traditionally organized society into bands, which served as the primary social unit for several hundred people.
The Comanche language originally began as a Shoshoni dialect before diverging to become its own separate language.
Comanche naming traditions often involved fathers asking a medicine man or another man of distinction to name their children.
Guitarist and recording artist Jesse Ed Davis is one of the notable figures associated with the Comanche people.
The Comanche fought numerous conflicts against Spanish, Mexican, and American armies throughout their history.
